question: In September 2022, who among the following was elected as President of Hockey India?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dilip Tirkey.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dilip Tirkey, a former India hockey captain and member of the gold medal-winning team at the 1998 Asian Games, was unanimously elected as Hockey India president on 23 Sept 2022.
 
• First time in history, a former sportsperson and an Olympian has been elected as the head of Hockey India.
 
• Tirkey, 44, has a record 412 international matches as a defender in his career spanning more than 15 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Hockey India plans, directs and conducts all the activities for both men's and women's hockey in India.
 
• It is responsible for promoting Hockey in India.
 
• It was formed after Indian Hockey Federation was dismissed in 2008 by IOA. 
 
• Hockey India:
 
 
• Headquarters: New Delhi
 
• Founded: 20 May 2009
 
• CEO: Elena Norman
 
• Men's coach: Graham Reid
 
• Women's coach: Janneke Schopman
 
 
 
• Sandeep Singh - Sandeep Singh is an Indian professional field hockey player from Haryana and an ex-captain of the Indian national hockey team. 
 
• Chitrashi Rawat is an Indian model, national level athlete and actress who is best known for her role as Komal Chautala in the Bollywood film "Chak De! India" (2007). 
 
• Rani Rampal is an Indian field hockey player who made her international debut at the age of 15, as a member of the Indian women's hockey team at the 2010 World Cup held in Rosario, Argentina. She hails from Shahbad Markanda, a small village in Haryana, and started playing hockey at a young age, despite facing numerous challenges and social stigma against girls playing sports.
